question: A photo album has 16 pages, and each page holds 4 photographs. One family filled 9 albums of that size with holiday pictures. The photographs were then shared equally between the 3 children in the family. One of them gave 164 of her photographs to her grandmother. Half of her pictures had been taken at the seaside. How many photographs does that child have left?

A decorator started a job with 45 tins of paint and bought 61 more. A supplier then sent 48 tins and a customer returned 41 unopened tins. All the tins were shared equally between the 3 crews on the site, and one crew carried its share up to the top floor. The building has 12 floors. That crew used 60 tins on the walls. The firm now needs 5 crews supplied with as many tins as that crew has left. How many tins will the firm need?

A theatre keeps all of its spare seat cushions in one store. On Friday morning the store held 226 cushions, and 29 more arrived from the upholsterer. In the afternoon 155 cushions were taken out for the matinee and never brought back. The theatre was built in 1890. That evening the manager ordered enough cushions for the store to hold 4 times as many as were left. The company now wants 7 theatres stocked in exactly the same way. How many cushions will the 7 theatres hold?

On Monday morning a school kitchen had 200 lunch trays in the rack. A delivery added 48 trays before break, and 8 were dropped and broken. At lunchtime another 48 trays came back from the dining hall. During the afternoon 133 trays were taken to the sports hall for a match. That evening the county ordered enough trays for the school to hold 6 times as many, and the trays were then shared equally between the 3 buildings on the site. Half of the trays are green. How many trays went to one building?

A bike shop records its repair jobs in hours rather than in minutes, and Ravi mends more punctures than his apprentice Lotte does. On Monday morning the shop had 40 inner tubes, and 25 of them were fitted to customers' bikes. In the afternoon a wholesaler delivered 8 times as many tubes as were left in the shop. That evening half of the tubes were sent to the shop's second branch. Overnight 4 tubes were found to be perished and were thrown away. How many inner tubes does the shop have now?

Priya's card company prints more than her rival Stefan's company does. Her store room was filled with 9 pallets, each holding 234 greeting cards. A second print run doubled the number of cards in the room. Over the year 1947 cards were sold from that room, and a shop returned 41 unsold cards to it. The company then opened 8 store rooms stocked to exactly that level, and repeated the whole plan in each of the 7 regions where it trades. How many greeting cards does the company hold in total?

A school keeps all of its raffle tickets in one box. The box held 44 books of tickets, and half of them were sent over to the infant school. Every book still in the box was then replaced by 6 books printed for the summer fair. The fair is always held on the 3rd of July. Half of the books in the box were sold in the first week and taken away. A parent then added 29 books that had not been used last year. How many books of tickets are in the box now?

On Saturday morning a tennis club found 22 balls in the ball basket, and half of them were too worn to use and were thrown away. Before lunch a member donated 66 new balls to the basket. In the afternoon the coach added 12 balls he had in his car. That evening a supplier delivered 41 more. How many balls are in the basket now?

An exam office keeps all of its spare answer booklets in one cupboard. The cupboard held 185 booklets, and 21 of them were used for a mock test. The printer then delivered 68 more booklets to the cupboard. Before the summer exams the office tripled the number of booklets in the cupboard. During the exams 425 booklets were handed out. How many booklets are in the cupboard now?

On Sunday morning a cafe cooked 72 pancakes and shared them equally between the 6 tables that were waiting, and Alma's table always eats more than Boris's table does. Before lunch Alma's table ate 4 of its pancakes. The cafe has 20 chairs. In the afternoon the cook made 4 times as many pancakes as were still on Alma's table and brought them over. That evening a neighbour dropped off 5 more pancakes for the same table. How many pancakes does Alma's table have now?

A railway depot keeps all of its spare sleepers in one siding. A delivery of 3 wagons brought 163 sleepers in each wagon to that siding. A track repair then used 358 of them. An inspector returned 19 sleepers that were still sound. Half of the sleepers in the siding were sent on to another depot. A footpath project took 35 more sleepers away. How many sleepers are left in the siding?

On Monday morning a bakery filled 5 trays with 61 pies on each tray and put them all in one warmer, and Ola bakes more pies than Timo does. Timo added 24 pies he had made the night before. Before lunch 220 pies were sold to a factory canteen. In the afternoon a school took 39 pies, and that evening a hotel collected 41 more. How many pies are left in the warmer?

A museum records its tours in hours rather than in minutes. On Friday morning the desk had 83 audio guides, and 50 were handed out to a coach party. Before lunch a school group took 8 more, and in the afternoon 14 went to other visitors. The museum has 9 galleries. That evening the director ordered enough guides for the desk to hold 4 times as many as were left. On Saturday 6 guides were sent away for repair. How many audio guides does the desk have now?

A crayon factory counts its output in single crayons rather than in boxes. Each tray holds 158 crayons, and every carton holds 4 trays. A pallet takes 6 cartons, and an inspector added 17 loose crayons to one pallet. The lorry is then loaded with 6 pallets of that size. Half of the crayons are made in bright colours. Schools ordered 19449 crayons from that lorry and a warehouse took another 504. How many crayons are left on the lorry?

A school office keeps all of its photocopies in one paper tray. On Monday morning the copier ran 8 batches of 207 sheets each into that tray. Before lunch 123 sheets were taken out for a test. In the afternoon the office ordered enough copies for the tray to hold 9 times as many sheets as it did. That evening a teacher added 40 sheets she had copied herself. The trust now wants 3 offices with trays holding as many sheets as this one. How many sheets will the 3 offices hold?

A stationer counts its invitations in single cards rather than in boxes. A wedding order was printed as 9 runs of 171 cards each. A faulty press spoiled 783 of the cards and they were pulped. The rest were shared equally between the 4 families involved, and one family took its share home, where half of the cards were found to be printed in gold ink. That family has now ordered 6 sets of the same size for other events. How many cards will that order come to?

A solar company keeps all of its panels in one depot. A delivery brought 8 lorries carrying 152 panels each. A housing job then took 458 panels from the depot. The company restocked so that the depot held 7 times as many panels as were left. An installer returned 16 panels that would not fit. A school roof used 564 panels and a factory roof took another 3879. How many panels are in the depot now?

A beekeeper filled 180 jars with honey during the summer. 140 of the jars were sold at the farmers' market. A neighbour returned 3 jars that had not been opened, and half of her jars carry a blue label. In the autumn 34 jars were given away as gifts and 4 were dropped and broken. She now plans 7 hives, each producing as many jars as she has left. A friend then gave her 4 filled jars from his own hive. How many jars of honey will she have?

On Saturday morning a greengrocer had 195 melons on the stall. By lunchtime 192 of them had been sold to a hotel. In the afternoon the wholesaler delivered enough melons for the stall to hold 4 times as many as were left. That evening 7 melons were sold, and on Sunday another 3 went. How many melons are on the stall now?

A decorating warehouse keeps all of its wallpaper rolls in one bay. The bay held 236 rolls, and a returned order added 13 more. The manager then ordered enough for the bay to hold 9 times as many rolls as it did. A national contract made the bay hold 4 times that number. Half of the rolls in the bay are patterned. A supplier finally added 17 sample rolls to the same bay. How many rolls are in the bay now?

A call centre logs its calls in minutes rather than in seconds, and keeps one running total for each team. On Monday morning one team's total stood at 178 minutes, and 51 minutes were struck off because of a recording fault. In the afternoon that team handled 6 times as many minutes as its total showed. That evening the figure for the whole floor came to 9 times the team's total, since 9 teams worked the same hours. The company's 9 sites all worked to exactly that pattern. How many minutes did the company log?

A coach company records its fares in whole dollars rather than in cents, and keeps one takings box. The box held 97 dollars on Monday, and Tuesday's trip added 66 dollars. A school booking then made the box hold 4 times as much as it did. A passenger paid 4 dollars for a late seat. A matching grant doubled everything in the box. How many dollars are in the takings box now?

On Monday morning a school stockroom took in 8 boxes of exercise books, with 25 books in each box. By the afternoon the supplier had delivered 9 times that many books for the whole year group. That evening the order was repeated for each of the 6 year groups in the school. A teacher added 49 books left over from last year and a parent donated 53 more. The school has 14 science labs. During the year 3927 books were handed out to pupils. How many exercise books are left in the stockroom?

A veterinary clinic counts its vaccine in single doses rather than in vials, and Dr Alvarez orders more of it than Dr Novak does. The fridge held 231 doses, and a delivery added 58 more. The health board then supplied 7 times that many doses for the county campaign. A neighbouring clinic sent over 50 doses it could not use, and a supplier added 26 doses as a sample. How many doses does the campaign have?

On Monday morning a playground project had 43 bags of wood chips on site, and a second lorry doubled that number before lunch. In the afternoon a supplier delivered 58 more bags. On Tuesday the council sent 35 bags. On Wednesday evening a landscaper dropped off another 58. How many bags of wood chips are on site now?
